turns.text: This is absolutely unacceptable! Your airline cancelled my flight and nobody has done a damn thing about it!
I'm sorry about that, and I want to help sort it out. Can I have your booking code and last name so I can pull it up?
It's T W nine V four B, Whitaker. And I want to know what you owe me, because I've lost two days of work over this!
Thank you, Ms. Whitaker, you're verified. I can see SK210 yesterday was cancelled by us, and I can rebook you free with no fare difference on the next available flight.
Rebook, great, so I get what I paid for, how generous! I want five hundred dollars for this mess, and I want a manager, now!
I understand how frustrating this is. I can't offer cash compensation beyond our policy, but I can arrange a supervisor callback for you.
A callback? I don't want a callback, I want a manager on this line, goddamn it! You people leave me stranded and then say no?

I'm sorry, I can't transfer you live, but I can put in a supervisor callback request right away. In the meantime, the next London flight is SK210 tomorrow at 08:10, or SK212 today at 14:30 with two seats left, and both are free for you.
Today? Fine, put me on the two thirty. But I'm still getting my five hundred, you hear me? What you owe me!
I've rebooked you on SK212 today at 14:30 at no charge. I can't promise the five hundred dollars, but I'll request that supervisor callback so they can review your concerns.
Unbelievable. Fine, have them call me, and they better call today. Is the 14:30 confirmed?
Yes, it's confirmed, and the callback is requested. To summarize, you're rebooked free on SK212 at 14:30 today and a supervisor will call you back.
